statement: ∀ (f : Module.End ℂ V) (a : LR.Lift M f) (r : ℕ) (d : LR.Lift M (LR.divided f r)), (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0 → LR.induced K M d.map = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (LR.induced K M a.map)^r
proof:
intro f a r d hn
have hp : ∀ n (m : M), ((a.map ^ n) m : V) = (f ^ n) m := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro m; rfl
  | succ n ih => intro m; simp only [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, a.agrees, ih]
have he : (r.factorial : ℤ) • d.map = a.map ^ r := by
  ext m
  change (r.factorial : ℤ) • (d.map m : V) = _
  rw [d.agrees, hp]
  simp [LR.divided, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℂ, smul_smul, Nat.factorial_ne_zero]
have hb := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℤ M => f.baseChange K) he
rw [LinearMap.baseChange_smul, LinearMap.baseChange_pow] at hb
have hs : (r.factorial : K) • LR.induced K M d.map = (LR.induced K M a.map)^r := by
  simpa only [LR.induced, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul, Int.natCast_smul] using hb
rw [← hs, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn, one_smul]

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (K : Type) [fieldK : Field K] (l : ℕ) (V : Type) [addV : AddCommGroup V] [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V]
  (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ l < p →
    LR.N1 l x y h v →
      (LR.N2 p l M x y v ∧ ∀ (q : ℚ), q ∈ LR.localRing p ↔ ∃ a d, ¬↑p ∣ d ∧ q = ↑a / ↑d) →
        LR.N3 p l M y v →
          (∃ (c : CharP K p), ∃ rho sigma A, LR.ResidueMaps K p c rho sigma) →
            (∀ (c : CharP K p) (rho : LR.R p →+* K) (sigma : LR.R p →+* ZMod p) (A : LR.Actions M x y h),
                LR.ResidueMaps K p c rho sigma → LR.Reduction K p l M x y h v A c rho sigma) →
              ∀ (f : Module.End ℂ V) (a : LR.Lift M f) (r : ℕ) (d : LR.Lift M (LR.divided f r)),
                ↑r.factorial ≠ 0 → LR.induced K M d.map = (↑r.factorial)⁻¹ • LR.induced K M a.map ^ r
